question: Should this PR keep closing the broader all-corpus timeout issue, or should the closing reference be narrowed so timeout-attribution/debug work remains tracked separately?
rationale: The code fix addresses the additive-latency root cause, but the linked issue also asks for more accurate timeout warnings and debug phase details that are handled by a separate open PR.

options.title: Narrow closure before merge
